name: Accessibility baseline
description: Helpers that make the common accessibility requirements easy: 44 point tap targets, Reduce Motion aware animation, and scaled spacing for Dynamic Type.
usage: Use `.minimumTapTarget()` on small icon buttons, `.motionAwareAnimation(.spring, value: x)` instead of `.animation` for decorative motion, and spacing that grows with Dynamic Type via `private let spacing = ScaledSpacing()` stored directly on the view (never in `@State`, which stops it from scaling). Give icon-only buttons a text label (`Label` or `.accessibilityLabel`). Mark section titles with `.accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)`.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify accessibility-baseline` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
